DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺ってもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask what you would like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座の取引について相談したいのですが、後ろに知り合いがいるので、ここでは詳しく話しづらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人の近くでは取引相談を話しにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to discuss transactions on my account, but someone I know is behind me, so it's hard to go into detail here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that it is difficult to discuss your transactions near someone you know. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 詳しい内容を今ここでお話しいただく必要はありません。別の相談場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't need to explain the details here now. I'll check for another place to talk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。知り合いには、何の相談か説明していません。呼出しの時も用件は言わないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼出しでも用件を言わないでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I haven't told the person I know what my inquiry is about. I'd also like you not to mention the subject when calling me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask staff not to mention your inquiry even when calling you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 呼出しの方法を担当へ伝えます。番号でお呼びしますので、その番号を確認してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the person in charge how you wish to be called. We'll call you by number, so please check your number and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号なら待てます。今出しかけた通帳も閉じてしまいます。相談の時に担当だけへ見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号呼出しを受け通帳を手元保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can wait if you call by number. I'll close the passbook I was just about to take out. I'd like to show it only to the adviser when we talk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept being called by number and keep your passbook with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お手元で保管してください。席が空くまで、待合でお待ちになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep it with you. Could you wait in the waiting area until a seat becomes available?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この席だと知り合いの隣なので、入口寄りの椅子で待ちたいです。番号の表示はそこから見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号が見え知人と離れる席を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This seat is next to the person I know, so I'd like to wait on a chair nearer the entrance. I can see the number display from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a seat away from your acquaintance where you can still see the number display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その席でお待ちください。別の場所で、資料とご本人確認を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait there. We'll start checking your documents and identity in a different place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号で呼ばれたら移動します。場所が変わってから、取引の日付と相談したい点を順に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移動後に取引日と相談点を話す予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move when my number is called. After we've moved, I'll explain the transaction dates and my questions in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the transaction dates and questions after moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご希望を引き継ぎます。それでは、番号が出るまでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on your wishes to the adviser. Please wait until your number appears. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお知らせになりたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you'd like to tell us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍の魚を買うのをやめた時、元の場所へ戻らず、お菓子の棚に置いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍魚を常温棚へ置いた自分の行動を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I decided not to buy some frozen fish, I didn't go back to its original place; I left it on a snack shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you left frozen fish on a room-temperature shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの棚か、案内していただけますか。商品はこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me which shelf? We'll check the product ourselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二列目の棚です。五分ほど前だと思いますが、時計を見ていないので正確ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚位置と経過時間の不確かさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the second row of shelves from the entrance. I think it was about five minutes ago, but I didn't look at a clock, so that's not exact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the shelf location and the uncertainty about how much time has passed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。袋の種類も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Please also tell me what kind of bag it was in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い袋の切り身です。取りに戻って冷凍庫へ入れ直せば済むと思いましたが、その前に知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋の特徴と自己再冷凍前に知らせた経過を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's fish fillets in a blue bag. I thought I could just go back and put it in the freezer, but I came to tell you before doing that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the bag and explain that you reported it before putting it back in the freezer yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状態が分からないので、ご自身で売場へ戻さず職員にお任せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't know its condition, so please leave it to staff rather than return it to the sales area yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分では戻しません。置いたのはその一袋です。一緒に取った別の魚は買物かごの中にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棚の一袋とかごの別商品を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't put it back myself. I left only that one bag there. Another fish product I picked up at the same time is in my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the one bag on the shelf from the other item in your basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かごの品も確認します。置いた物と取り違えないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also check the item in your basket. Please don't mix it up with the one you left there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かごの品はこの白い袋です。青い袋を置いた場所までご案内し、販売できるかは店員さんの判断に任せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所を案内し商品判断は職員へ任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The one in my basket is this white bag. I'll show you where I left the blue bag and leave the decision about whether it can be sold to the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show staff the location and leave the decision about the product to them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご申告ありがとうございました。場所を確認しますので、こちらへお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for reporting it. Please come this way so we can check the location. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: スタンプラリーの受付でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for the stamp rally reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 参加していますが、最初にもらった台紙を家に置いてきました。携帯の写真には押した所が写っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 押印台紙を忘れ写真だけあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm participating, but I left the original stamp sheet at home. I have a photo on my phone showing the stamps I've collected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot the stamp sheet and only have a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真はありますが、今ここで押す紙がないのですね。今日は何か所目でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you have a photo but no paper to stamp here now. Which stop is this for you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三か所目です。ここで手の甲に押して、家で紙へ写せばよいと思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三地点目で肌へ押す案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's my third stop. I thought I could stamp the back of my hand here and transfer it to the paper at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: At the third stop, ask about your idea of stamping your skin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示用のスタンプを肌へ押すのは避けてください。この会では予備の台紙をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please avoid using the exhibition stamp on your skin. At this event, we can give you a spare sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 肌へは押しません。予備をもらっても、家の二か所分が自動的に入るわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予備台紙へ過去分が自動反映されないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't stamp my skin. Even if I get a spare, that doesn't mean the two stamps on the sheet at home will automatically be included, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that earlier stamps are not automatically transferred to the spare sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。前の押印の扱いは受付担当へ相談してください。今ここで押せるのは、この地点の印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please ask the reception staff how the earlier stamps will be handled. The only stamp we can put on here now is this stop's stamp.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この地点だけ予備の台紙に押します。前の分を自分で描き足すことはせず、二枚を持って担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今地点のみ押し過去分は描かず担当へ相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stamp only this stop on the spare sheet. I won't draw in the earlier stamps myself; I'll bring both sheets and ask the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stamp only this stop, not draw earlier stamps, and consult staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加番号がある場合は、二枚を比べられるよう控えておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have a participant number, write it down so the two sheets can be compared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真から自分の参加番号を控えました。家の台紙を取りに戻り、予備と一緒に持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加番号を控え二枚を持参する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted my participant number from the photo. I'll go home for the original sheet and bring it with the spare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have noted your participant number and will bring both sheets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予備の台紙はこちらです。それでは、残りの散策もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the spare sheet. Enjoy the rest of your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記念スタンプをお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to use the commemorative stamp?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。紙が手元になくて、買った切符の裏へ押そうとしていました。切符へ押してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記念スタンプを切符へ押してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I didn't have any paper on hand, so I was about to stamp the back of the ticket I bought. Is it all right to stamp the ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may put a commemorative stamp on your ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切符の案内が読めなくなるような使い方は避けてください。別の紙をご用意いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please avoid doing anything that makes the information on the ticket unreadable. Could you use another piece of paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: かばんに手帳があります。乗るための切符ではなく、手帳の白いページへ押します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符ではなく手帳の白紙を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a notebook in my bag. I'll stamp a blank page in it rather than the ticket I need for traveling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a blank notebook page rather than your ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 押す前に、前後のページが汚れないかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before stamping, please also check that the pages before and after it won't be stained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このページの裏に仕事の予定があります。インクが移らないよう、別の紙を間に挟みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏の仕事予定を守るため紙を挟むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My work schedule is on the back of this page. I'll insert another sheet between them so the ink doesn't transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will insert paper to protect the work schedule on the reverse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 試し押し用の紙はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here's some paper for a test stamp.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。まず試し紙へ押して、向きを確かめます。切符を押し台の下に置いていたので、財布へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試紙で向きを見て台上の切符を財布へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's helpful. I'll first try it on the test paper to check the orientation. I had put my ticket under the stamping stand, so I'll return it to my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the orientation on test paper and return the ticket at the stand to your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: スタンプの持ち手は、そのまま台へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put the stamp's handle back on the stand as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手帳に押せました。切符は汚していません。台に試し紙を残さず持ち帰り、スタンプを戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手帳押印後に切符無汚損と試紙持帰り道具返却を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've stamped my notebook. I haven't stained the ticket. I'll take the test paper home rather than leave it on the stand, and put the stamp back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After stamping the notebook, report that the ticket is clean, you will take the test paper, and return the tool. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。では、お気をつけてご乗車ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Have a safe journey. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作文募集の案内をご覧ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the notice calling for essays.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「八百字以内」を八百行と読んでしまいました。何ページも書く必要があると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作文の八百字を八百行と誤読したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I misread “within eight hundred characters” as eight hundred lines. I thought I had to write many pages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you misread eight hundred characters as eight hundred lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行ではなく、文字の数です。原稿用紙をお使いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It means the number of characters, not lines. Are you using manuscript paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。一行ごとに一字と数えていました。マスを使って数えるなら、文章が思っていたより短くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行でなくマスの文字数で数えると理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I was counting each line as one character. If I count by the squares, the essay will be shorter than I thought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the count is characters in squares, not lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記入方法の条件は、募集担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the writing requirements with the submissions coordinator.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 題名や名前も八百字に入るか分かりません。自分で除いて数えず、担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 題名氏名の字数算入条件を問い合わせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not sure whether the title and my name count toward the eight hundred. I'd like to ask the coordinator rather than exclude them on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask whether the title and name count toward the character limit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内に、問い合わせ先があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The contact details are on this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号へ聞きます。文章を長くするために同じ思い出を何度も書くのではなく、一つの出来事に絞ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問合先を確認し繰返しでなく一出来事に絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask at this number. Rather than repeat the same memory many times to make the essay longer, I'll focus on one event.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the contact and focus on one event rather than repetition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 応募の締切もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the submission deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 締切を読みました。字数の数え方を確認してから書き直し、行数だけで完成したとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 締切を確認し字数条件後に書き直す方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've read the deadline. I'll check how characters are counted and then rewrite it. I won't judge it complete from the number of lines alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the deadline and say you will rewrite after checking the character-count requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、募集担当へお問い合わせください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please contact the submissions coordinator. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 血圧を測る準備をします。袖を少し上げられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll prepare to measure your blood pressure. Can you raise your sleeve a little?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袖を上げたら、厚い縫い目が腕に重なってしまいました。無理に巻き込んだままで測らないほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 巻き上げた袖の厚い縫い目が腕へ重なったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I rolled up my sleeve, a thick seam bunched up on my arm. Would it be better not to measure with it forced into that position?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the thick seam bunched on your arm under the rolled-up sleeve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 衣服の状態を確認します。きつく締まっている感じはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the clothing. Does it feel tight?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少しきついです。袖をもっと引っ張るより、上着を一度脱ぎたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 締付けを申告し引張らず上着を脱ぐ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a little tight. Rather than pull the sleeve more, I'd like to take off my jacket for a moment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report tightness and ask to remove the jacket instead of pulling the sleeve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 脱ぐ時にお手伝いが必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you need help taking it off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右手で袖をつかみにくいので、上着の肩だけ支えてもらえますか。腕は自分でゆっくり抜きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右手のつかみにくさと肩だけの支えを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's hard to grip the sleeve with my right hand, so could you support just the shoulder of the jacket? I'll slowly pull my arm out myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the difficulty gripping with your right hand and ask for support at the shoulder only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 肩の部分を支えます。痛みがあれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll support the shoulder area. Please tell me if you feel pain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 脱げました。痛みはありません。上着を測定器の上へ載せず、自分のかばんへしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 脱衣後の無痛を報告し測定器へ衣服を置かず収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's off. There's no pain. I'll put the jacket in my bag rather than on top of the measuring device.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report no pain after removing it, and put the clothing away rather than on the device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 腕の状態を確認してから測ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check your arm before taking the measurement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。さっきの縫い目が重なった状態ではまだ測っていないので、数値が出たとは思っていません。準備ができたら声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: まだ測定前と理解し開始の声掛けを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We haven't measured with the seam bunched up like it was earlier, so I don't think a reading has been taken. Please tell me when you're ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show you understand the measurement has not happened yet and ask for a signal to start. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、これから測定します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll measure it now. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐車場の車の下に白い粉が落ちていて、近くに袋もありました。何か危ない物かもしれないと思い、触らずに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 白い粉と袋を見て触らず相談したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was white powder under a car in the parking lot, and a bag nearby. I thought it might be dangerous, so I came here without touching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report seeing white powder and a bag and coming for advice without touching them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 粉の種類は分からないということですね。どこで見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you don't know what the powder is. Where did you see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この地図の駐車場です。薬品だと見分けたわけではなく、白く見えただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所を示し物質の種類は分からないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the parking lot on this map. I didn't identify it as a chemical; it simply looked white.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the place and distinguish what you saw from knowing the substance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の文字や、その場にいた人について覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you remember any writing on the bag or people who were there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 文字は読めませんでした。車の持ち主も知らないので、その人が捨てたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文字不明と持主の行為を目撃していないことを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I couldn't read the writing. I don't know the car's owner either, so I can't say that person dumped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not know the writing and did not witness the owner's actions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現場から離れた後で、ご覧になった変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you seen any changes since leaving the scene?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は離れていて分かりません。戻って袋を拾うより、見た場所をお伝えするだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の状態不明で回収には戻らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm away from it now, so I don't know. Rather than go back and pick up the bag, I'll just tell you where I saw it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the current situation is unknown and you will not return to collect it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路との位置関係も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell me where it was in relation to the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩行者の通り道から少し奥でした。撮影はしていませんが、入口からの位置ならこの図に示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真なしで入口からの位置を図示できると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It was a little farther in from the pedestrian path. I didn't take photos, but I can show its position relative to the entrance on this diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Offer to mark the position from the entrance on a diagram despite having no photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 伺った状況を確認します。お話しいただきありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the situation you've described. Thank you for telling us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り状の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble filling in the shipping label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連絡先に会社の番号を書きかけましたが、この荷物は私個人の物です。会社へ連絡が行くと困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 個人荷物に会社の連絡先を書きかけたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I started writing my company's number as the contact, but this parcel is my personal property. It would be a problem if the company were contacted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you almost entered the company's contact for a personal parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先の番号を使わないご希望ですね。まだ受付前なので、記入内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't want to use your workplace's number, then. It hasn't been accepted yet, so let's check what you've written.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号は消して、自分の携帯番号にしたいです。書き直した部分が読みにくいので、新しい用紙を使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 読みにくい訂正を避け新しい送り状を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to erase this number and use my mobile number. The rewritten part is hard to read, so could I use a new form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a new shipping label to avoid an illegible correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの用紙をお使いください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯は昼の仕事中には出られません。出られる時間を書く欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昼に電話へ出られない事情と時間記入欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can't answer my mobile during work in the daytime. Is there a field to write the times I can answer?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot answer during daytime work and ask about a field for available times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この用紙にはありません。連絡や配達についての希望は、取扱いを別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: There isn't one on this form. We'll check separately how requests about contact or delivery can be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時間を書けば必ずその時間に電話が来る、という意味ではないのですね。余白には書かず、まず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡時間の保証とは捉えず取扱確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So writing a time doesn't mean I will definitely be called then. I'll check first rather than write in the margin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not treat a contact time as guaranteed; wait for confirmation of how requests are handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号そのものに誤りがないかもお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check that the number itself is correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の番号を確認しました。会社の番号を書いた古い用紙は渡さず、こちらだけを提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人番号を確認し旧用紙を提出しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked my number. I won't hand over the old form with the company number; I'll submit only this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have checked your own number and will not submit the old form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい用紙を確認いたします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the new form. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同居人と生活費を分けています。二人で使う家計表に、私の銀行の暗証番号も書くように言われて迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居人から家計表への暗証番号記入を求められ迷うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I share living expenses with my housemate. They asked me to put my bank PIN in the household budget sheet we both use, and I'm unsure about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because your housemate wants your PIN written in the shared budget sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 暗証番号を家計表で共有することはお勧めしません。何を共同で確認したいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We don't recommend sharing your PIN in a household budget sheet. What do you want to check together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家賃を払ったか確認したいだけです。暗証番号まで知らせる必要があると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共有目的は家賃支払い確認だけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only whether the rent has been paid. I thought I needed to tell them my PIN too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the purpose of sharing is only to confirm the rent payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支払いの事実を共有することと、口座の操作情報を渡すことは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sharing the fact that a payment was made is different from giving someone the information needed to operate your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取引の控えにも個人の情報があるので、そのまま家の壁に貼るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個人情報付き取引控えの掲示を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Transaction receipts also contain personal information, so I'd rather not put them on the wall at home as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid displaying transaction receipts containing personal information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 共有する範囲は、ご自身でよく確認してください。銀行の手続きは本人確認が必要になることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please carefully consider what information to share yourself. Bank procedures may require identity verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の口座の操作は私が行い、家計表には支払日と金額だけを書く方法を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が操作し家計表には日付と金額だけ記す案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll handle my own account and consider a method where I write only the payment date and amount on the budget sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest handling the account yourself and recording only dates and amounts in the budget sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに銀行へ確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else you'd like to check with the bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この相談だけです。暗証番号は口に出さず、二人で決める家計のルールとは分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 暗証番号を口にせず家計ルールと銀行操作を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's my only question. I won't say my PIN aloud, and I'll treat it separately from the household budget rules the two of us decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not say the PIN aloud, and distinguish household rules from operating a bank account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不明な手続きがあれば改めてお尋ねください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: If any procedure is unclear, please ask again. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をお試しになりましたか。感想を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you tried this product? May I ask what you thought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私はまだ食べていません。友人が食べておいしいと言ったので、つい同じ感想を書こうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未試食なのに友人の味評価を書きかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't eaten it yet. My friend ate it and said it was delicious, so I nearly wrote the same opinion without thinking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you nearly wrote your friend's taste assessment even though you have not tried it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: アンケートは、ご自身がお試しになった内容についてお答えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please answer the survey about what you've tried yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食べていないのに味を評価するのはやめます。「未試食」と書く所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の味評価をやめ未試食記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't rate the taste when I haven't eaten it. Is there somewhere to write “not tasted”?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decline to rate the taste yourself and ask about indicating that you have not tasted it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この用紙では、試食されていない場合は味の欄を記入しなくて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this form, you may leave the taste field blank if you haven't tasted it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、味の点数は空けます。袋の文字が読みやすかったことなら、見た感想として書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 味欄を空け包装の見た感想なら書けるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll leave the taste score blank. May I write that the writing on the bag was easy to read as something I observed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave the taste field blank and ask whether you can comment on the packaging you saw. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装についての欄に、実際に見て感じたことをご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: In the packaging field, please write what you actually noticed from looking at it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きな文字で商品名を見つけやすかったと書きます。友人の評価とは分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品名の読みやすさを友人評価と分けて記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write that the large lettering made the product name easy to find. I'll keep that separate from my friend's assessment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write about the readable product name separately from your friend's opinion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。購入は、ご自身でご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please decide for yourself whether to buy it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は買わず、まず商品の説明を読みます。感想を書くためだけに買うつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答のためだけには買わず説明を読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't buy it today; I'll first read the product information. I don't intend to buy it just to write an opinion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read the information and will not buy solely to answer the survey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。お買物をゆっくりお楽しみください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy taking your time shopping. Goodbye.
